page.overview:
Who is Garuda?

Sometime after his battle with Itachi Uchiha, Sasuke found and signed a contract with Garuda to replace his ability to fly from his lost Cursed Seal of Heaven.

While resembling a normal hawk, he is much larger in terms of size. He was depicted as being brown in colour while having darker areas along his back, wings, and tail. Garuda also has dark markings around his eyes as well as red ones along the sides of his beak.

Garuda seems to be very loyal to Sasuke.

During his fight with Danzō Shimura, Sasuke summoned Garuda to avoid falling off the Samurai Bridge after being injured by Danzō's Wind Release: Vacuum Sphere technique. Sasuke later disembarked from him in order to evade the Wind Release: Vacuum Wave while it flew towards them.
